The first video game console for the home, the Magnavox Odyssey, came out in 1972 — it had no sound at all.
Tetris was created in 1984 by Alexey Pajitnov, a Soviet engineer, on an Electronika 60 computer.
Minecraft is the best-selling video game of all time, with more than 300 million copies sold.
Pac-Man was designed to appeal to everyone, not only boys — its name comes from the Japanese 'paku paku' (to chomp).
The PlayStation 2 is the best-selling home console ever: over 155 million units.
Mario was first called 'Jumpman' when he appeared in Donkey Kong in 1981.
The Witcher 3 has around 450,000 words of dialogue — longer than many novels put together.
In Grand Theft Auto V, the map of Los Santos is based on real Los Angeles and its suburbs.
Esports tournaments fill real stadiums: League of Legends World finals have drawn more than 40,000 people.
The 'Konami Code' (↑ ↑ ↓ ↓ ← → ← → B A) was added to Gradius so its developer could test the game more easily.
Elden Ring's world was built with help from George R. R. Martin, the author of Game of Thrones.
The Sims became free to play in 2022 — the base game of The Sims 4 costs nothing.
Microsoft Flight Simulator streams real satellite data, so you can fly over your own house.
Baldur's Gate 3 has 17,000 possible endings according to Larian Studios.
Forza Horizon 5 launched with more than 500 cars on a map based on Mexico.
